final: SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_by_country, AVG(pav.points_won) - (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(pav2.points_won) as country_avg FROM player_award_vote pav2 JOIN player p2 ON pav2.player_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY p2.death_country)) as difference FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(pav2.points_won) as country_avg FROM player_award_vote pav2 JOIN player p2 ON pav2.player_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY p2.death_country)) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country
